findings.detail: A thrown execution with receipts:[] and unknown_usage:true is treated as knownzero. Explicit uncertainty or contradictory attached usage must hold pair reservation and remain unreconciled.
Failure reading/comparing persisted pair after execute returns discards available returned accounting. Preserve returned result/receipts and trustworthy known components as evidence.
accountReceipts throwing inside worker catch can leave a null outcome and prevent a fixed terminal report. Retain raw evidence and an unreconciled pair with bounded reservation instead.
